emails.subject: Procurement packages, vendor lead times and PO dates for baseline L2/L3 (ACTIONS-000-007)
emails.body:
Aziz,

As promised, here are the procurement packages, RFQ / award / delivery dates and vendor lead times for the baseline L2/L3. They follow Procurement Plan Rev A (HEL001-G000-P-&PRC-00001-A). Dates are my planning basis today. Vendor budget quotations are still being collected, so I mark each lead time as 'vendor-indicated' or 'HEP assumption'. I will reissue the table when the quotations are in.

1. Main equipment packages (RFQ issue / award-PO / delivery window)
- P01 PV modules, 206,500 x 620 Wp TOPCon bifacial, DDP site (A610): RFQ 5 Jan 2027, award and Module Supply Contract 15 Feb 2027 (M06). First delivery on site 20 Jul 2027 (M09), then roughly 12-14 weeks of deliveries. Vendor-indicated production plus transit about 16-20 weeks from PO, so M09 holds only if the PO is not later than 15 Feb.
- P05 220/33 kV power transformer (plant substation): RFQ 4 Jan 2027, bids back 29 Jan, award and PO 12 Feb 2027. Lead time 36-40 weeks incl. FAT, so delivery 15 Nov - 15 Dec 2027. This leaves about 5 weeks to M10 (20 Jan 2028). It is the critical item.
- P04 Inverter stations, 28 x 3.6 MVA incl. MV transformers and switchgear (VoltEdge): RFQ 18 Jan 2027, award and PO 26 Mar 2027. HEP assumption 28-32 weeks, delivery in batches from late Oct 2027 to Dec 2027, matched to PV1-PV4 energisation sequence.
- P03 Single-axis trackers for 128 MWp incl. piles design support (AxisTrack): RFQ 11 Jan 2027, award and PO 5 Mar 2027 so that pile design input is available before first piles on 12 Apr (M08). HEP assumption 14-18 weeks to first delivery, first trucks to site early Jul 2027, full delivery by Oct 2027.
- P06 BESS 50 MW / 100 MWh LFP containers, PCS, EMS (CellCore): RFQ 25 Jan 2027, award and PO 30 Mar 2027. HEP assumption 30-34 weeks, delivery Jan-Feb 2028 against M12 (15 Apr 2028).
- P02 and P07 (MV/LV and DC cables, 220 kV OHTL materials): RFQ following engineering specifications due 31 Dec 2026; RFQ dates to be fixed once Elena issues them. Cables are not yet in the L2 logic below.

2. Transformer actions
- I will ask the transformer manufacturers whether a factory slot can be reserved with a Letter of Intent before the PO on 12 Feb (your request REQ-005-epc-plan). I will also ask for alternative offers at 32-34 weeks. I expect a reservation fee, and any LOI commitment needs Rajan's approval and Thomas's wording. I will report the answer by 10 December.
- The RFQ date of 4 Jan depends on Elena issuing the technical specification on 18 Dec, as Rajan instructed. The Meridian 10 working day review must start with the RFQ, not after it. I have set a 10 working day window for technical bid clarification and QSE/Meridian vendor approval inside 29 Jan - 12 Feb.
- Recovery options: split shipment of the transformer does not exist, so only the LOI slot, a shorter-lead alternative supplier, and a shortened commissioning window in the schedule can help. Please show the transformer on the critical path with zero float in the baseline.

3. Logistics and customs assumptions for the schedule
- Modules, trackers, BESS and inverter stations arrive by sea to Black Sea / Caspian ports or China rail via Kazakhstan, then road to site over the 12 km track from the A-380. Transit allowance: 35-45 days rail, 55-70 days sea plus rail. Transformer: heavy-haul road transport with route survey, about 3 weeks from the border or port.
- Customs clearance allowance 7-10 working days per consignment at Navoi or the border; I will work with Shavkat Bobojonov's office for the import duty exemption documents. First module consignment should be cleared 3 weeks before M09.
- The 12 km access track must carry 40 t transformer loads and heavy trucks by early Q3 2027. Sanjay should confirm road upgrade timing.

4. What I need to close the picture
- Dilnoza: please enter the dates above as procurement logic (RFQ - bid evaluation - award - manufacture - ship - customs - site) for each package and send me the draft L2 procurement chain for review before 21 Dec.
- Elena: specification dates for P02, P03, P04, P06 and P07 against the RFQ dates above. Late specifications are my biggest risk to these dates.
- Li Wei will collect written lead-time confirmations from vendors by 12 Dec (ties to your REQ-006-epc-plan).

I also owe Thomas his SC-01 to SC-04 boundary confirmation by 9 Dec and will send it separately.

Regards,
Mehmet Yildiz
Supply Chain Manager, HEP

row.notes: Award 12 Feb 2027; 36-40 week lead; critical to M10; LOI for factory slot being explored
